name: JobCapture - Job Application Tracker
description: One-click capture of job postings. Track openings, deadlines, and job details without juggling tabs and spreadsheets.
author: Tamar Hayrikyan

data_collection_consent.message: JobCapture stores job posting data (titles, companies, URLs, salaries, deadlines, notes) locally on your device using browser storage. This data never leaves your computer—there are no external servers, no accounts, and no tracking. You can export or delete your data at any time from the tracker.
